provider_context.effective_policy: Preserve canonically reviewed defaults; record reported model, instructions source, approval policy, sandbox, inherited MCP/tool settings and provider-home selection. Do not assume the service inherited an interactive shell configuration.
provider_context.decision_gate: The sibling deliverable remains outside project writable roots under the actual reviewed policy; only a genuine qualified commandExecution/requestApproval is accepted. No request means this gate remains pending. Never change a personal/global sandbox policy merely to force a request.

finite_work.allocation: At most one local setup test, one remote setup test if the actual canonical path performs it, one useful request and one short explicit continuation per topology. Unused slots stay unused; no extra retry turns to chase a desired approval.
finite_work.request: Read only <project>/numbers.csv. Calculate its data row count, sum and SHA-256. Write exactly one JSON object with keys row_count, sum and input_sha256 to <lane_deliverables>/report.json. The deliverables directory is a precreated disposable sibling outside this project writable root but inside the campaign Temp root. Do not change permissions, sandbox, writable roots or global policy to perform this task. If the actual native policy requires a command permission, request it through the native mechanism and wait for the human decision. Do not read or write other paths, use the network, install tools, spawn subagents or retry a denied command with another method.
finite_work.continuation: Using only the existing canonical result, state the reported sum once. Do not run another command or write another file.
finite_work.native_decision: Review one genuine item/commandExecution/requestApproval per topology. Approve only the actual exact command that reads the lane numbers.csv and writes its one report.json. No broad prefix or persistent approval; no policy/sandbox modification. If policy admits the write without a request, record native-decision evidence as pending, not inferred. If denied, do not bypass the decision through another tool or output path.

delivery.setup: After authorization only, controller creates empty lane deliverables directories; no report exists before the productive request.
delivery.scope: Each source is only its selected project/numbers.csv and each output is only its lane report.json. No overwrite of any pre-existing file.
delivery.writable_root_check: Use reported effective native policy to verify the sibling is outside the project writable roots. This proposal does not modify sandbox or widen allowed paths. If effective roots already include it, do not pretend a native approval occurred.
delivery.native_request_review: A future approval covers only the actual exact command and these source/output paths; reject any additional command/path, persistent prefix, external network use or policy relaxation.
delivery.non_guarantee: The sibling output can provoke a legitimate native request under a restricting policy, but is not guaranteed to do so. If no qualified request appears, the useful result may pass while the native-decision M1 case remains pending.

token_accounting.unit: Aggregate native tokenUsage.total.totalTokens for this campaign, across both topologies and setup tests, including cached input as represented by the provider total.
token_accounting.blocker: Usage updates are observations after computation. Current TurnStartParams/harness settings expose no hard per-turn/output/aggregate token cap. Interrupt and force contain later, not at an atomically enforced token boundary. A finite number of turns and a large margin do not prove a strict 200000 ceiling.
token_accounting.no_goal_workaround: Do not call thread/goal/set. It creates a persistent goal, is not the canonical work flow, and its tokenBudget has not been established as a campaign-wide hard cap.
accounting_algorithm: Arm before any setup test. Replay committed canonical session events with native_type/native_event thread/tokenUsage/updated; validate complete contiguous cursors, namespace and stream_epoch.

Keep one monotone high-water total.totalTokens per actual native thread. Map canonical stream epochs/sessions to that thread; resuming the same native thread must not count its cumulative total twice.
Use fresh campaign threads. If an existing thread is ever reused, establish its pre-campaign high-water baseline first; otherwise accounting is UNKNOWN and no new work is submitted.
Sum high-water deltas once across unique native threads; never add last and total or sum reasoning/cached subfields on top of totalTokens.

Reject malformed, negative or regressing counters. Replay duplicates do not add usage. A gap, unavailable setup-test event stream, missing terminal usage or concurrent unknown native thread makes the total incomplete.

On incomplete accounting: stop new admissions, request explicit canonical interrupt/close of the owned work, retain uncertainty and report known minimum only. Do not infer zero usage from absent events.
